title: SRP Mods
description: Mod pack with horror and new chunk generation
body:
This modpack transforms Minecraft into a richer, more immersive survival experience while keeping the core vanilla feel intact. World generation is dramatically expanded with Biomes O’ Plenty, Tectonic, Incendium, Underground Worlds, and Beyond Vanilla, creating breathtaking landscapes, deeper caves, enhanced Nether environments, and countless new places to explore. Structures from Medieval Buildings and its Nether Edition make exploration more rewarding, while Friends & Foes, More Mobs, Bogged Spawn, Shifting Wares, and other additions bring new creatures, encounters, and challenges to the world.

Atmosphere is a major focus. Ambient Sounds, Sound Physics Remastered, The Darkness Will Find You, Server-Side Horror, Dream Displays, and Brightness Aura create a more dynamic environment where every cave, forest, and structure feels alive. Visual upgrades such as 3D Skin Layers, Continuity, Iris, and Xaero’s Minimap enhance immersion without straying far from Minecraft’s original style.

Performance has also been heavily optimized. Sodium, Lithium, Krypton, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, Dynamic FPS, EntityCulling, C2ME, TNT Optimizer, Chunky, and Debugify work together to improve frame rates, reduce memory usage, accelerate world generation, and fix numerous vanilla issues. Utility mods like Jade, JEI, Waystones, Ping Wheel, Portable Villager, and Mod Menu make gameplay smoother and more convenient.

Supported by essential libraries and frameworks including Fabric API, Balm, CreativeCore, Resourceful Lib, TerraBlender, Lithostitched, Collective, GlitchCore, and Forge Config API Port, this pack delivers a polished, optimized, and content-rich Minecraft experience that emphasizes exploration, atmosphere, and quality-of-life improvements.
